body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 3805a6c4e003d4efb98446cdcb1e20e64acc1e2e -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- The refusal is correct. It does not hide a defect. I read the law in the code:
  - `operation::material_source` gives a 3D Pocket the model's own XY silhouette as its machine area (`Pocket3D` arm, projection of the facets).
  - `machining3d/ladder.rs:101-132` takes that area, removes the part's section and shadow at each level, then erodes it by the tool radius plus stock to leave. An empty result skips the level.
  - `ladder.rs:353-356` returns the `GenError::Empty` text when every level was skipped.
  - The sample as imported lies on its side. At each level the area left outside the part's section is a thin sliver. A 6 mm end mill does not fit. Nothing cuts and nothing posts. This is the "visibly refused" case of the Prime Directive.
- The message names the wrong reason ("the model fills the pocket"). That is a wording defect, already tracked as #1709 (P7). It is not a safety defect.
- Coverage is kept. The heavy test still generates the 3D Finish S1 over the full Z span and verifies that no gate problem is a gouge. `the_sample_laid_flat_generates_3d_finish_and_pocket_with_no_gouge` still covers a Pocket plus Finish job that generates. The old test never passed, so no passing coverage is lost.
- No product code, golden or snapshot changes. The decision file is present. The body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #1706`.

**Results** (locally, merged with main: "Already up to date")
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test shared_face_bodies` (debug) | 5 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored (heavy), 26.6 s |
| `cargo test --release -p camcraft-app --test shared_face_bodies -- --ignored the_sample_as_imported_still_generates_the_3d_finish --exact` | **passed**, test time 1695.65 s (about 28 min). Total wall time with the release build: about 31 min. |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --test shared_face_bodies -- -D warnings` | clean |
| Mutation: I changed the refusal text in `ladder.rs` to `MUTANT` | `the_sample_as_imported_refuses_the_3d_pocket_by_name` FAILED as expected. I restored the file. |

I did not start a `pr-test.yml` run (a cut is in progress).

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
1. The heavy test takes about 28 min in release (the author's estimate of 15+ min in debug is too low for debug; I did not run debug). AGENTS.md says a test over about 60 s in debug moves to the heavy lane or gets a slimmer fixture. It is already in the heavy lane with its lane named. A slimmer fixture is a follow-up for the maintainer to decide.
2. The new default test pins the message text. When #1709 changes the wording, this test must change with it. It would be more robust to assert only the refusal (`isError`) plus a short stable fragment such as "nothing to cut".

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
